Class StatusList

java.lang.Object
com.authlete.cbor.CBORItem
com.authlete.cbor.CBORPairList
com.authlete.cbor.tsl.StatusList
public class StatusList extends CBORPairList
The StatusList structure.

Definition

 StatusList = {
     "bits" : 1 / 2 / 4 / 8,     ; The number of bits used per Referenced Token
     "lst"  : bstr,              ; Byte string that contains the Status List
     ? "aggregation_uri" : tstr  ; link to the Status List Aggregation
 }
Since:
1.21

  • Constructor Details

    • StatusList

      public StatusList(int bits, byte[] lst, String aggregationUri)
      A constructor with bits, lst, and optional aggregation_uri.
      Parameters:
      bits - The number of bits per Referenced Token in the compressed byte array (lst). The allowed values for bits are 1, 2, 4 and 8.
      lst - The status values for all the Referenced Tokens it conveys statuses for.
      aggregationUri - The URI to retrieve the Status List Aggregation. This parameter is optional.

      public byte[] getLst()
      Get the status values.
